ModMetaData.name: Automated Work Assignment
ModMetaData.author: Ekinox0310
ModMetaData.description:
Tired of constantly juggling pawn work priorities as your colony grows? Do you wish assignments better reflected pawn passions and skills? Automated Work Assignment is here to help!
This mod intelligently assigns work priorities based on both Skill Level and Passion, while giving you detailed control through the Mod Settings menu and convenient buttons directly on the main Work Tab. Spend less time micromanaging priorities and more time managing your colony!
Key Features:
Smart Assignment: Intelligently prioritizes pawns by considering both their relevant Skill Level and Passion (Minor/Major) for each work type.
Emergency Priority: Automatically assigns Priority 1 (Highest) to essential roles like Doctor and Firefighter for designated pawns, ensuring critical tasks are handled swiftly.
Detailed Configuration (via Dedicated Settings Window): Say goodbye to cluttered menus! Automated Work Assignment features its own standalone, draggable, and resizable window with collapsible categories.
- Simple Mode: Set the desired number of pawns and target manual priority (1-Highest to 4-Lowest) for each job type. - Expert Mode: Advanced controls for each job type, allowing you to set minimum skill thresholds, required passions, and backup priorities. - Exclude specific colonists: Prevent the mod from changing the priorities of selected individuals using the "Manage Excluded Pawns" dialog. Ideal for your dedicated specialists! - Toggle Automatic Daily Refresh: Choose whether the mod automatically re-evaluates and assigns priorities once near the start of each day.
Enhanced Work Tab UI: Adds convenient buttons directly to the main Work tab for instant control: - Enable/Disable Mod: Quickly toggle the mod's entire assignment logic ON or OFF. - Refresh Now: Manually trigger a reassignment check at any time (if the mod is ON). - Mod Settings: Direct access to the configuration window.
Experimental Features (WIP): - Player Profiling / Heuristics: A work-in-progress module intended to learn from your manual assignments. Please note: This feature is currently a Work In Progress (WIP) and does nothing functionally yet—it only collects contextual data in the background if enabled (which is stored locally and is not uploaded anywhere).
Compatibility: Designed to automatically detect and manage work types added by other mods. New jobs will appear in the settings automatically.
Requires Harmony.
Languages: Supports English, Spanish (Español), French (Français).
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Q: Is this compatible with mods adding new work types?
A: Yes. The mod dynamically finds all available work types and includes them in the settings and assignment logic.
Q: Is this compatible with "Work Tab" by Fluffy?
A: Likely conflicts. Both mods alter the Work Tab and priority system. Using both simultaneously might cause visual glitches or unexpected behavior where one mod overwrites the other. It's generally recommended to use only one mod for managing work priorities.
Q: Is this compatible with AI/Scheduling mods (Achtung!, Pawn Rules, etc.)?
A: Generally, yes. This mod sets the numerical priorities (1-4). Other mods usually work based on reading those priorities to decide task execution. Testing is always recommended, but major conflicts are unlikely.
Q: Does this mod impact performance / cause lag / lower TPS?
A: It should have a very minimal impact. The automatic daily refresh runs the main logic only once per game day. The checks performed more frequently are extremely lightweight. Manual refresh only uses resources when clicked. It's designed to be much more performance-friendly than mods that react to every single skill change.
Q: How does the mod decide which pawn is 'best'?
A: In Simple Mode, it calculates a score based on the pawn's relevant Skill Level plus a bonus for Passion. In Expert Mode, you can tightly customize this logic by setting rules based on skill level thresholds.
Q: Can I exclude specific pawns?
A: Yes! You can globally exclude pawns using the "Manage Excluded Pawns" button, meaning the mod will never touch any of their priorities. Alternatively, in Expert Mode, you can use "Manage Job Exclusions" to prevent a pawn from being assigned to one specific job type, while still letting the mod manage their other tasks.
Q: Can I manually override an assignment?
A: Yes. You can turn the mod OFF globally, globally exclude a specific pawn, exclude a pawn from a specific job, or set the 'Desired Count' for a job to 0 (which sets everyone to priority 0 for that job).
Q: Does the mod respect Zones, Schedules, Outfits, etc.?
A: Yes. The mod only sets the priority numbers (1-4 or 0). All standard RimWorld rules regarding allowed areas, work times, required apparel, tool usage, etc., still apply and are handled by the base game.
Q: Why isn't Pawn X doing Job Y even if assigned Priority 1?
A: Check standard RimWorld reasons: Is there another task with Priority 1? Is the pawn restricted by Zone? Is it time for Sleep/Food/Recreation according to their schedule? Are they injured or ill (Patient/Bed Rest)? Do they have the required materials/tools? Can they pathfind to the location? The mod doesn't override these core game mechanics.
Q: Does the mod manage 'Patient' or 'Bed Rest'?
A: No, not directly. These are health states automatically prioritized very highly by the game itself based on pawn needs. The mod helps by ensuring the 'Doctor' job is forced to Priority 1 for assigned pawns, ensuring patients get treated promptly. You cannot set a count/priority for 'Patient'/'Bed Rest' in this mod.
Q: Can I add this to an existing save?
A: Yes, it should be safe to add to existing saves. Configure the settings and use "Refresh Now" or wait for the daily refresh to apply the initial priorities.
Please let me know if you encounter any bugs.
